scripts.zip:all: npm run zip:chrome && npm run zip:firefox
scripts.zip:chrome: npm run build:chrome && (cd dist-chrome && mkdir -p ../artifacts && zip -r ../artifacts/microscape-minion-$npm_package_version-chrome.zip . -x '*.DS_Store')
scripts.zip:firefox: npm run build:firefox && web-ext build --source-dir dist-firefox --artifacts-dir artifacts --overwrite-dest --filename microscape-minion-{version}-firefox.zip
scripts.firefox:lint: npm run build:firefox && web-ext lint --source-dir dist-firefox
scripts.firefox:run: npm run build:firefox && web-ext run --source-dir dist-firefox
